ops.title: PR269: heal persisted pack lists after same-mtime changes
ops.description: Owner: Yasyf Mohamedali <yasyf@poetic.com>. Next: avoid treating mtime alone as a durable pack-list generation; invalidate on managed pack publication or apply racy-timestamp handling and heal stale manifests after a miss. Evidence: internal/gitobj/object_pack_read.go:126; /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/ccn-write-floor-review/pr269-_qireoxt/pack-results.txt:1 through :3. A new managed pack with restored directory mtime remains absent from the manifest on two fresh opens; both return correct data through native cat-file fallback.

ops.text: With a new managed pack and unchanged directory mtime, a fresh process discovers the new managed pack and repairs the manifest rather than repeating Git fallback indefinitely.
